patterns.when: New or poorly understood workflow; no proven benefit to automation
patterns.human_gate: Any external effect needs owner action

patterns.when: One bounded request requiring reasoning or a limited tool lookup
Distinct domains require separate specialist instructions or access
patterns.fallback: Return to coordinator on ambiguity or routing loop
patterns.success_measure: correct routing with no permission drift

patterns.when: Output of each step is a necessary input to the next
patterns.fallback: Stop at last verified checkpoint; retain earlier outputs
patterns.human_gate: Owner approves any remote deployment or publication

patterns.when: Independent evidence streams benefit from concurrent bounded research
patterns.fallback: Use available branches; mark unsearched authorities
patterns.human_gate: No research worker gets write authority

patterns.when: Complex task has unpredictable subtasks with a bounded time/cost budget
patterns.fallback: Stop when cost/time cap reached and preserve partial work
patterns.human_gate: Manager cannot approve external actions or delegate more access
patterns.success_measure: accepted tasks per cost and elapsed time

patterns.when: Clear measurable quality rubric and revision improves outputs
Verified source change must propagate without silent loss or duplicate events
patterns.fallback: Retry with backoff, dead-letter and manual recovery without cursor advance
patterns.human_gate: Owner authorizes connector/schedule; no duplicate writers
patterns.success_measure: sync lag and replay duplication count

patterns.when: Operation affects money, customer data, publication, permissions or deletion
patterns.human_gate: Specific owner approval immediately before external effect
